newsitem.title: FRANCE: Snecma has 95.57 pct of SEP.
newsitem.headline: Snecma has 95.57 pct of SEP.

text.p: French aero engine company Snecma said on Thursday that at the close of its public offer for rocket motor maker Societe Europeene de Propulsion (SEP) on December 10, it held 95.57 percent of SEP's capital.
With more than 95 percent of SEP shares, Snecma will now go ahead with a mandatory offer to withdraw the stock outstanding at 625 francs per share, as planned.

Snecma, which will then hold all SEP's capital, said it would rationalise operations and bring it closer to Snecma, both of which were needed to strengthen the whole group, particularly in the brakes sector.

Snecma's new chairman Jean-Paul Bechat said on November 4 at his first news conference he wanted to reinforce the group's activities in aeronautics and space, and considered the space and brakes sectors vital to the group's future.
"Taking full control of SEP will ensure the future of Snecma in space programmes and in technologies of the future," he said. It will also allow the consolidation of the brakes activities," he added.
Snecma previously held 51 percent of SEP.
